objective: Qualify the engine-worker process profile with no-model stand-ins
flags: ENGINE_ENABLED stays false; no job policy requests the profile yet
deviations: The token gains the registryRead capability: without it, any process creation from a worker in a less-privileged AppContainer fails with ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED on Windows 11 26300 (lpacCom, lpacAppExperience, lpacInstrumentation and lpacCryptoServices do not help). It is added for the engine profile only
Output is capped (64 MiB, run fails with LIMIT_EXCEEDED) for engine workers only; media workers' output stays uncapped as on main, since a cap silently truncated FFmpeg output

Profile versioning/hash and out-of-bounds refusals; descendant bound (media 0, engine 3 of 3, bound 4 gives 3, bound 2 gives 1); sentinels, TCP to a local HTTP server and DNS denied with uncontained controls; no descendant outlives worker exit, cancel, service exit, procd kill or the wall budget (exit 1460, wallExceeded); output past the cap fails the run, under it and media output complete; COM cannot be initialized (noinit 0x80070005) so no WMI access through COM in root\cimv2, root\subscription and root\default (controls connect) and no COM server; Task Scheduler create refused with the host's access-denied text (control creates); breakaway denied 5; junction writable folder refused (real folder accepted); registryRead opens the product key (media denied), not SAM, HKCU or any write. Diagnostics on this host: outside DNS qualified only with network; breakaway control fails when the test runs inside a job
